_readme: Keys starting with underscore are ignored. One entry per provider id. Fields: name, base_url, env[], hosts[], signup_url, docs, models_endpoint, protocols{}, headers{}, quirks[], verified (date), source, note, unverified (true = author general knowledge, models.dev wins when it has an api field). Add entries here as providers are verified; leave signup_url null to let the apex-domain inference run.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
quirks: Free tier: :free model variants share a quota of 1,000 requests/day per key, reset 00:00Z
Account privacy/guardrail settings can produce 404s for models that exist
Not every model supports tool calling; check the model's supported_parameters

opencode.name: OpenCode Zen (Console pay-as-you-go)
quirks: Every paid text model is served through every API family above; Console translates when needed
Free-tier chat models answer HTTP 403 outside OpenCode, even with a key; use paid models or Go
Keys: personal API keys or service-account keys (oc_sk_...) from the Console
Some clients use their own env names (Hermes: OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY)
Paid use draws on Console credits
opencode.source: opencode docs: console/api/inference, console/go, console/harnesses, console/models (2026-11-08)

opencode-go.name: OpenCode Go (subscription)

headers.x-opencode-session: <required: stable session id per conversation (native Claude Code/Codex/Hermes/Pi session headers also work)>
headers.User-Agent: <your client's own name/version, e.g. my-coding-agent/1.0, not a generic SDK or HTTP-library UA>

quirks: Meant for coding-agent traffic; usage is monitored for abuse
Each model has a native API, but every text model also works through the other API families
In opencode itself: /connect -> OpenCode Go, model id opencode-go/<model-id>
Some clients use their own env names (Hermes: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY)
No documented API for remaining usage; see the Console's Go page (Extra Usage pays from credits)
opencode-go.source: opencode docs: console/api/inference, console/go, console/harnesses, console/models (2026-11-08)
